title: Background Agents in Slack Integration
description: Cursor announced Background Agents in Slack integration, allowing users to launch agents directly from Slack by mentioning @Cursor. Agents can read threads, understand context, and create PRs without leaving the conversation. Also includes search in settings with Cmd/Ctrl+F, MCP progress notifications, dynamic tool registration, and roots support.

community_feedback.quote: Cursor background agents in Slack changed my workflow
You say @cursor do my work in Slack and Agent is the same as what you see running in Cursor. An LLM loop that thinks, executes code, and edits files directly from Slack.

title: Version 2.1.105 - Enhanced Worktree Support and Security Fixes
description: Claude Code v2.1.105 added path parameter to EnterWorktree tool for switching into existing worktrees, PreCompact hook support, background monitor support for plugins, and /proactive alias for /loop. Includes critical security fixes: improved Bash tool permission handling, fixed stalled API streams with 5-minute timeout abort, and improved network error messages. Also improved /doctor layout, /config labels, and WebFetch to strip style/script contents.

title: April 2026 Updates - SDK Public Preview, Cloud Agent Enhancements
description: GitHub Copilot released multiple updates in April 2026: Copilot SDK in public preview, Copilot cloud agent with research/plan/code capabilities, Copilot CLI now supports BYOK and local models, organization runner controls for cloud agent, and usage metrics now identify active/passive code review users. Also includes mobile refresh with native session logs and GPT-5.4 mini availability.

title: Version 0.37.0 - Dynamic Sandbox and Browser Enhancements
description: Gemini CLI v0.37.0 implemented dynamic sandbox expansion and worktree support for Linux and Windows. Introduced 'Chapters' narrative flow for better session structure, and enhanced browser agent with persistent sessions and dynamic tool discovery.

title: Adaptive Model Router & Quota System Update
description: Windsurf introduced an Adaptive model router that intelligently selects the best model for each task. Updated model picker with pricing context, prompt cache timer, and token counts in response cards. Fixed bug with adaptive router preventing model switching after first request.

community_feedback.quote: All users who encountered the bug have had quota reset and overage restored

title: PR Resumption and Platform Improvements
description: Devin announced PR resumption capability allowing agents to take over existing pull requests across sessions. Includes minor bug fixes and polish: sidebar collapse state persistence, improved PR loading without GitHub integration, repository branch dropdown enhancements, mobile responsive layout improvements, build logs auto-scroll, Ctrl+O prompt expansion, shell security improvements, and GitLab PAT rotation fixes.

title: Version 0.86.0 - GPT-5 and Grok-4 Support
description: Aider v0.86.0 added support for all GPT-5 models and Grok-4 via xAI and OpenRouter. Also added support for Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, new /context command for identifying files to edit, co-authored-by attribution enabled by default, and /commit-language option.

title: Version 1.3.38 - Config and Workspace Improvements
description: Continue v1.3.38 includes config.yaml fixes, session history filtering by workspace directory, .continue/configs support, JetBrains remote config sync improvements, and Gemini 3 tool support with suffix stripping and thought_signature features.

title: Version 0.104.0 - WebSocket Proxy and Notification Support
description: Codex CLI 0.104.0 added WS_PROXY/WSS_PROXY environment support for websocket proxying, and app-server v2 now emits notifications when threads are archived/unarchived. Fixed Ctrl+C/Ctrl+D to cleanly exit during cwd-change prompts.
